The Half-Life of Facts - Why Scientific Truths Keep Changing - Francis Glassborow - ACCU 2025 Short Talks
---

Can you trust what you know today to still be true tomorrow? In this lightning talk from ACCU 2025, Francis Glassborow explores the half-life of facts - how scientific facts evolve, why our knowledge is constantly being revised, and what this means for critical thinking in a rapidly changing world.

From flat Earth theories and outdated chromosome counts to the redefinition of planets and surprising reversals in medical advice, this talk challenges the assumption that facts are fixed. Glassborow weaves together historical examples and scientific milestones to show that mutable facts and scientific uncertainty are not flaws, but features of how human knowledge grows.
